artists.source_line: For information contact with DANCE TRAVEL:

features.rationale: The parties take place in Don Angel Hotel, the same hotel where dancers are invited to stay.
The description lists a pool party from 17h to 21h.
Daytime workshops in dedicated rooms are part of the programme.

features.quote: 2 rooms for the parties during the night
features.rationale: Two separate dance rooms are used for the night parties.
A Wednesday pre-party is listed in the programme before the main parties.
The location section says the event includes shows.

features.quote: PRICE (per person and day with FULL BOARD):
features.rationale: The per-day room prices are for full-board packages that include accommodation.
The room prices are stated as full board, so meals are included in the package.

features.quote: INFORMATION ABOUT SHUTTLE FROM BARCELONA AIRPORT OR GIRONA AIRPORT
features.rationale: The description gives bus and train shuttle options from the airports to the hotel.
